services.title: Interior Redecorating
services.desc: We transform living spaces with smooth, even finishes. Whether it's one room or your entire home, our painters prep thoroughly and use quality paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's outside surfaces. We handle woodwork, rendering, and fascias — weatherproofing your Bristol property for years to come.

services.title: Feature Walls & Murals
services.desc: Add character to your rooms with bespoke feature walls or custom murals. We work with you to realise your design vision.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation for pattern-perfect rooms, or efficient removal of old coverings before redecoration.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and window frames deserve precision. We sand, prime, and paint for a cabinet-quality finish.

services.title: Commercial Repainting
services.desc: Bristol shops, offices, and rental properties benefit from our tidy, quick turnaround. We work flexibly to minimise disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do the job right, and actually care about your walls.
about_para_1: Best Coat Decorating has been brightening Bristol homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started with a simple idea: the local painter shouldn't charge like a London firm or disappear mid-project. Today, we're known across Easton, Southville, and beyond for reliable, skilled work and no hidden costs.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up when we say we will, leaving your property cleaner than we found it, and standing behind every coat of paint. We listen to what you want, suggest colours and finishes that work, and take pride in the difference a fresh coat makes.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Best Coat Decorating

reviews.text: Had our living room and hallway done. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Colour advice was spot on too. Would definitely use them again.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house needed work badly. They stripped the old paint, repaired the woodwork, and left it looking brand new. Honest quote, no extras, brilliant job.

reviews.text: Feature wall in our kitchen is stunning. They got the pattern perfectly straight and the finish is flawless. Very reasonable price. Highly recommend.
